title: Determinantal capacity and $L^\infty$-Estimates
summary: We introduce determinantal ellipticity, or det-ellipticity, a quantitative structural condition for fully nonlinear elliptic operators on compact Kähler manifolds that provides the link between the $L^\infty$-estimates and algebraic/combinatorial properties of a large class of Hessian elliptic operators. On the analytic side, we introduce $\mathcal D$-subsolutions extending the determinant sublevel condition of Sui--Sun.
